news.h: Dak Prescott: Cowboys can make playoffs without making trade
news.d: Dallas quarterback Dak Prescott said the Cowboys have enough talent to be a playoff team without a trade deadline addition.

news.h: Javonte Williams' late TD run helps Cowboys avoid another 4th-quarter collapse and beat Colts 27-23
news.d: — With the Dallas Cowboys trailing by three points and on the verge of yet another fourth-quarter collapse, Dak Prescott needed 29 seconds to bail them out.
